After saying this, Xiao Gang makes an exaggerated expression. The audience hears this sudden joke, and they all start to laugh.

[Question]
Why does Xiao Gang say this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Xiao Gang says this to use humor and jokes to relieve the tension of the audience.
B. Xiao Gang says this because he has a special view on the lighting effects in the drama, and wants to provoke the audience to think about it.
C. Xiao Gang says this because he really thinks that the stage lighting has a special source, and wants to express his admiration for stage technology.
D. Xiao Gang says this because he wants to show his sense of humor, increase his personal charm in the drama, and attract the attention of the audience.
